stage_definitions.discovered: the file is listed in the discovery inventory (paper_results/discovery)
stage_definitions.eligible: adequately specified genuine UMAT (registry D2): Abaqus UMAT interface, distinct, constitutive content, builds as published, every USEd module published, material constants published
stage_definitions.attempted: the transform-all pass selected and ran this source
stage_definitions.transformed: the transformer produced OTI Fortran for this source
stage_definitions.compiled: the transformed build compiled in at least one layout (offline gfortran store build, or the Abaqus/ifort job build); per-layout statuses are under `layouts`
stage_definitions.original_executed: the ORIGINAL routine ran to completion in Abaqus on the verification deck
stage_definitions.oti_executed: the OTI build ran to completion in Abaqus on the same deck
stage_definitions.primal_agreed: stress and state history of the OTI build agreed with the original over the whole run (gate primal_agreed)

primal_stress_state.quantity: STRESS and STATEV history of the OTI build
primal_stress_state.held_fixed: deck, PROPS, loading path
primal_stress_state.rule: decided by the Abaqus primal gate (D-15, tolerance rule routine_primal_gate/1): verified iff the comparison(s) named in decided_by measured paired calls with ratio <= 1 and gates abaqus_job_completed, complete_history_finite, primal_agreed and mechanically_informative are all true; max_error is the ratio of the deciding comparison; failed only when a deciding comparison measured a ratio > 1; a process failure (control job incomplete, no paired calls, no init build) is inconclusive, or not_attempted when nothing was measured, with process_failure naming it; an original undefined on the history (D-12) is undefined_in_original; the FE history comparison is informational only (measured.fe_comparison_informational). Records from before the gate keep abaqus_primal_history_floor/1

ddsdde.quantity: DDSDDE = d STRESS_{n+1} / d (strain-increment driver)
ddsdde.wrt: the increment driver (DSTRAN, or the deformation gradient for finite-strain sources)
ddsdde.held_fixed: incoming STRESS/STATEV, PROPS, TIME, TEMP
ddsdde.rule: verified only from merged D-4-compliant evidence on the store build (FD of the ORIGINAL routine with restored state, FD-only plateau >= 3 steps, entrywise tolerance rule, ratio <= 1) AND only while primal_stress_state is verified; otherwise a merged verified is shown as inconclusive. The pass's Abaqus tangent gate is carried as ddsdde_legacy_gate with its tangent_verdict (verified / failed / unresolved): from G10 it is the D-4 gate, before G10 the legacy plateau rule; it is never counted here

family.basis: Vera ruling (corpus_campaign/batches/B10/vera_pre22b/REPORT.md): Vera: viscoelastic. Sub-tag: Eyring viscoplastic, no threshold, saturating hardening. Sensitivity: other (viscoplastic). | Scout B10: B3 rules (corpus_campaign/batches/B3/scout/rules.md), precedence 5 (rate-dependent plastic flow -> other/viscoplastic); confidence medium; UNCERTAIN: The Eyring sinh flow has no explicit yield threshold. Under the literal rule-table wording (viscoelastic = rate-dependent with NO yield surface) the row could be viscoelastic. I kept other/viscoplastic because of the plastic hardening variable and the author's viscoplastic framing (framing is explanation, not evidence).; Sub-tag: chemo-mechanical viscoplastic glassy polymer (effective-temperature approach). The equilibrium hyperelastic branch is parallel to an elastic-viscoplastic branch with Eyring flow, tau_eq = asinh(eta/C1)/(Vp/kBT_eff), where C1 = eta0*exp(-dG/kBT + Hp) and Hp is a hardening saturating with the accumulated plastic strain. DTIME enters the plastic update. Hydrolytic degradation enters only through Mn and water fraction, read once from a file into STATEV(10:11) in SDVINI and never updated in the UMAT. They set T_eff, which scales the moduli, activation energy and hardening, so they act as spatially varying material parameters rather than an evolving damage variable multiplying stress: rule 4 does not apply.

D0_discovered_files.means: acquired sources plus discovered candidate files that were never acquired

D1_acquired.means: every source the acquisition brought back (registry records)

ddsdde_legacy_gate.what: the pass's Abaqus tangent gate by derived tangent_verdict (passed = verified, failed = a measured disagreement, unresolved = neither); the D-4 gate from G10, the legacy plateau rule before it. Shown here, never counted in features.ddsdde

features_other_builds.what: verified on the lifted/provider build -- a different build of the source than the Abaqus pipeline's; counts over the rows that have such a cell, never pooled with summary.features

families.classification: D-11 S1: Scout's B3 code-evidence family review (corpus_campaign/batches/B3/scout/families_reviewed_B3.json), with the identity-growth scaffolds (Jeff97, growth tensor fixed to the identity) counted as growth; rows B3 did not check take E (corpus_run/material_families_checked_E.json) mapped to the same names

E_secondary.what: Agent E's classification (material_families_checked_E.json); shown for comparison, never the reported family

definitions.verified: the stage's own evidence says it passed; transformed, compiled or executed never imply verified downstream
definitions.inheritance: a stage with no evidence of its own inherits blocked / not_applicable / unsupported from the stage above it, and is not_attempted when the stage above failed
definitions.conflict: independent evidence says both verified and failed; both are listed in the cell and neither is counted
definitions.inconclusive: evidence that neither establishes nor refutes the claim
definitions.undefined_in_original: the ORIGINAL's output differs between init builds (D-12): a source defect, never compared, counted neither verified nor failed
definitions.features: summary.features counts the Abaqus-pipeline (store) build only; lifted/provider cells are in features_other_builds

denominators_note.eligible_now_means: adequately specified genuine UMATs in the registry as built for pass22
denominators_note.why: the D-11 family denominators were stated against the earlier registry's eligible set; every figure in this manifest uses the eligible set computed now

feature_sources.guard: a primal/ddsdde cell verified in the primal+ddsdde run is merged as inconclusive when the full-feature run shows failed/conflict or a hidden-state trip for it
